reason: While AssignmentSource.to_dict() leaves queued as a datetime object (src/sentry/integrations/services/assignment_source.py:18,27-28), Sentry configures Celery to use pickle rather than JSON serialization (src/sentry/conf/server.py:739-741), and neither sync_assignee_outbound (src/sentry/integrations/tasks/sync_assignee_outbound.py:15-21) nor its apply_async call (src/sentry/integrations/utils/sync.py:136-145) overrides the serializer to JSON. Both pickle and Sentry's holds_bad_pickle_object check (src/sentry/celery.py:28-55) allow datetime values, so passing to_dict() as task kwargs does not raise TypeError.
